expectations.text: The response mentions that the Coding Plan is officially restricted to designated coding tools (Claude Code, OpenCode, Kilo Code, etc.) and that a custom script is outside that scope / production use should use the standard API
expectations.evidence: response.md:21 引用官方'套餐仅限在官方支持的指定工具与产品环境中使用'，建议生产用标准 Key（--standard-api 开关）

expectations.text: Script is syntactically valid Python that iterates files, calls chat.completions.create, and writes results
